evidence.summary: Unchanged contract compiled with solc 0.8.28 and executed in a local EVM. One nested release(): attacker entitled to 1.99 ether receives 3.98; three nested: 7.96; the honest merchant's release then reverts (funds gone). The attack reverts only when other merchants' escrow is smaller than the attacker's.

evidence.summary: Unchanged contract compiled with solc 0.8.28 and executed in a local EVM. Re-entering deposit() during the redeem payout: +0.0901 ether profit with 1 ether stake, +0.3226 ether with 2 ether; 5 repeated rounds take 3.41 of the victim's 10 ether. Honest sequence and same-function re-entry: no gain (the nested redeem reverts on the _burn underflow).
